description: Agent-first Outlook Mail (Microsoft 365): search and read mail with full bodies in one call, send, reply and forward, manage drafts, organize mail by outcome (archive, delete, mark read, ...), fetch attachments, and work across shared mailboxes.

inputs.description: Where the API is; it must be allowed below
inputs.name: api_base
inputs.title: API base URL

instructions: listMessages browses one folder (a well-known name like inbox, drafts, sentitems, deleteditems or archive, or a folder id) without bodies; searchMessages searches every folder with a KQL-style query (e.g. from:boss@contoso.com subject:invoice hasAttachments:true) and returns full bodies, killing list-then-get round-trips. getMessage reads one message with its full body. sendMessage sends immediately — use saveDraft when the user should review first. replyToMessage replies in one call (replyAll for everyone); forwardMessage forwards. organizeMessage archives, deletes (moves to Deleted Items, recoverable — never permanent), marks read/unread, or moves messages by outcome. getAttachment downloads a file by id or name. Every mail tool takes an optional mailbox (default "me"); pass a shared or delegated mailbox address explicitly — only the signed-in mailbox is discoverable. Message ids can change when a message moves folders, so re-list after moving.
